7. The hardness route remains unconstructed

The additional fault-tolerance sources checked do not provide a native reduction.

Menon and collaborators’ magic-state construction requires correcting nondeterministic stabilizer signs on hardware before the transversal $CCZ$, and its implementation requires the specified code couplings or reconfigurable permutations. Those operations cannot be silently inserted into this nonadaptive bounded-range experiment. journals.aps.org [https://journals.aps.org/prx/pdf/10.1103/ghhp-cytl?utm_source=chatgpt.com]

The single-shot code-switching construction of Tan and collaborators uses expander-based HGP codes. Its “2D HGP” terminology does not supply a bounded-range embedding into the physical square lattice. arxiv.org [https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.08552?utm_source=chatgpt.com]

Nor can every corrective Clifford be postponed to classical readout. For a fixed POVM $\{M_x\}$, a stochastic relabelling implements a correction $V$ for every input state exactly only if

$$V^\dagger M_yV=\sum_xR(y\mid x)M_x.$$

For rank-one projective readout, this requires $V$ to be monomial in the measurement basis. An arbitrary Clifford need not satisfy it.

An all-branches flagged construction could avoid conditioning on one exponentially rare success event, but it would still need a native compiler and a valid robust hardness reduction for its unconditional joint law. Neither is supplied by these source results or by this return.
